title: A2UI Conformance Executed-Case Manifest Record
description: JSON Schema validating a single JSON Lines record in an A2UI conformance executed-case manifest.

harness.description: Identifier of the conformance harness that executed the test case.

suite.description: Suite file path relative to conformance/, using forward slashes.

case.description: Test case name, or test id for map-form suites.

status.description: Execution status of the test case.

reason.description: Non-empty explanation required when status is skipped or xfailed.
